verses.text: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
lines: Hear my teaching, my people.
Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.text: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
lines: I will open my mouth in a parable.
I will utter dark sayings of old,

verses.text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
lines: Which we have heard and known,
and our fathers have told us.

verses.text: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
lines: We will not hide them from their children,
telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh,
his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

verses.text: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
lines: For he established a covenant in Jacob,
and appointed a teaching in Israel,
which he commanded our fathers,
that they should make them known to their children;

verses.text: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
lines: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born;
who should arise and tell their children,

verses.text: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
lines: that they might set their hope in God,
and not forget God’s deeds,
but keep his commandments,

verses.text: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
lines: and might not be as their fathers,
a stubborn and rebellious generation,
a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal,
whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

verses.text: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
lines: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows,
turned back in the day of battle.

verses.text: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
lines: They didn’t keep God’s covenant,
and refused to walk in his law.

verses.text: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
lines: They forgot his doings,
his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

verses.text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
lines: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers,
in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.text: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
lines: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through.
He made the waters stand as a heap.

verses.text: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
lines: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud,
and all night with a light of fire.

verses.text: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
lines: He split rocks in the wilderness,
and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

verses.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
lines: He brought streams also out of the rock,
and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.text: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
lines: Yet they still went on to sin against him,
to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

verses.text: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
lines: They tempted God in their heart
by asking food according to their desire.

verses.text: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
lines: Yes, they spoke against God.
They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

verses.text: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
lines: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out,
and streams overflowed.
Can he give bread also?
Will he provide meat for his people?”

verses.text: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
lines: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry.
A fire was kindled against Jacob,
anger also went up against Israel,

verses.text: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
lines: because they didn’t believe in God,
and didn’t trust in his salvation.

verses.text: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
lines: Yet he commanded the skies above,
and opened the doors of heaven.

verses.text: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
lines: He rained down manna on them to eat,
and gave them food from the sky.

verses.text: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
lines: Man ate the bread of angels.
He sent them food to the full.

verses.text: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
lines: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky.
By his power he guided the south wind.

verses.text: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
lines: He also rained meat on them as the dust,
winged birds as the sand of the seas.

verses.text: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
lines: He let them fall in the middle of their camp,
around their habitations.

verses.text: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
lines: So they ate, and were well filled.
He gave them their own desire.

verses.text: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
lines: They didn’t turn from their cravings.
Their food was yet in their mouths,

verses.text: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
lines: when the anger of God went up against them,
killed some of their fattest,
and struck down the young men of Israel.

verses.text: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
lines: For all this they still sinned,
and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

verses.text: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
lines: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity,
and their years in terror.

verses.text: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
lines: When he killed them, then they inquired after him.
They returned and sought God earnestly.

verses.text: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
lines: They remembered that God was their rock,
the Most High God, their redeemer.

verses.text: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
lines: But they flattered him with their mouth,
and lied to him with their tongue.

verses.text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
lines: For their heart was not right with him,
neither were they faithful in his covenant.

verses.text: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
lines: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them.
Yes, many times he turned his anger away,
and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

verses.text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
lines: He remembered that they were but flesh,
a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

verses.text: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
lines: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness,
and grieved him in the desert!

verses.text: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
lines: They turned again and tempted God,
and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
lines: They didn’t remember his hand,
nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

verses.text: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
lines: how he set his signs in Egypt,
his wonders in the field of Zoan,

verses.text: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
lines: he turned their rivers into blood,
and their streams, so that they could not drink.

verses.text: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
lines: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them;
and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.text: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
lines: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar,
and their labor to the locust.

verses.text: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
lines: He destroyed their vines with hail,
their sycamore fig trees with frost.

verses.text: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
lines: He gave over their livestock also to the hail,
and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.text: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
lines: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger,
wrath, indignation, and trouble,
and a band of angels of evil.

verses.text: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
lines: He made a path for his anger.
He didn’t spare their soul from death,
but gave their life over to the pestilence,

verses.text: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
lines: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt,
the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

verses.text: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
lines: But he led out his own people like sheep,
and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.text: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
lines: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid,
but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.text: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
lines: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary,
to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

verses.text: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
lines: He also drove out the nations before them,
allotted them for an inheritance by line,
and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.text: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
lines: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God,
and didn’t keep his testimonies,

verses.text: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
lines: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers.
They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

verses.text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
lines: For they provoked him to anger with their high places,
and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

verses.text: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
lines: When God heard this, he was angry,
and greatly abhorred Israel,

verses.text: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
lines: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh,
the tent which he placed among men,

verses.text: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
lines: and delivered his strength into captivity,
his glory into the adversary’s hand.

verses.text: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
lines: He also gave his people over to the sword,
and was angry with his inheritance.

verses.text: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
lines: Fire devoured their young men.
Their virgins had no wedding song.

verses.text: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
lines: Their priests fell by the sword,
and their widows couldn’t weep.

verses.text: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
lines: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep,
like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

verses.text: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
lines: He struck his adversaries backward.
He put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.text: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
lines: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph,
and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

verses.text: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
lines: But chose the tribe of Judah,
Mount Zion which he loved.

verses.text: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
lines: He built his sanctuary like the heights,
like the earth which he has established forever.

verses.text: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
lines: He also chose David his servant,
and took him from the sheepfolds;

verses.text: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
lines: from following the ewes that have their young,
he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people,
and Israel, his inheritance.

verses.text: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
lines: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart,
and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
